newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil finishes the week higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil finishes the week higher.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run finished the week on a stronger note, with mildly firmer crude lending support and a cargo deal suggesting a mini-recovery, traders said.
A Scandianavian refinery was heard to have sold to a U.S. refiner/trader at $94 fob for material to go trans-atlantic.

The deal helped the sector up on Friday, coming back from Tuesday's low of $89.50 fob for very prompt material. Friday's seller was heard to have pegged his offer for mid-May barrels up to an optimistic $98 fob.
Russian cargoes were also offered higher, with two E-4 cargoes priced at three means plus $4. An E-4 from Klaipeda was on offer at three means plus $2.
A British major was heard to be still hoovering up Russian cargoes.
